en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard showing a tranquil village scene. A large, two-story building labeled 'Gasthof Gävernitz' is central, with people and a horse-drawn carriage in front. Leafless trees line the street, and their reflections are visible in a body of water in the foreground. The setting is quiet and appears to be in early spring or winter. The text on the postcard is in German, printed in a classic serif font, and includes a publisher's mark.
